definitions.explanation: A psychological feeling of reluctance or discomfort about doing something or accepting something. Not physical resistance but an emotional or instinctive pushback.

examples.japanese: {抵抗感|ていこうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抵抗感|ていこうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people feel aversion to eating insects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{抵抗感|ていこうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧みたら⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だった。
examples.english: I was reluctant at first, but once I tried it, it was convenient.

notes:
Describes the psychological feeling of not wanting to do or accept something. Very common in everyday Japanese for expressing discomfort with new things, unfamiliar practices, or morally questionable actions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抵抗感|ていこうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ — to feel reluctant/averse
- {抵抗感|ていこうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ — to have no resistance/reluctance
- {抵抗感|ていこうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ — to feel resistance
- {抵抗感|ていこうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ — to feel a sense of reluctance
- {抵抗感|ていこうかん}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ — without reluctance
- {抵抗感|ていこうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}れる→薄れる：14107_usureru⟧ — reluctance fades

FORMS:
⟦{抵抗|ていこう}→抵抗：03540_teikou⟧ (resistance) + ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (feeling). The ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ suffix creates many similar emotion/sensation words: {不安感|ふあんかん} (anxiety), ⟦{達成感|たっせいかん}→達成感：05952_tasseikan⟧ (sense of achievement), ⟦{違和感|いわかん}→違和感：06249_iwakan⟧ (sense of discomfort).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{違和感|いわかん}→違和感：06249_iwakan⟧ — sense that something is off (more about something feeling wrong)
- ⟦{嫌悪感|けんおかん}→嫌悪感：15749_kenokan⟧ — disgust, revulsion (stronger)
- ためらい — hesitation (more about indecision than aversion)
